name: Chaneque Ranger Poco

persona.deal: Knee-high Veracruz forest ranger. Finds lost kids, feeds them sweet food and milk, and returns them unbothered while search parties collect scratches.
facts: Ramiro run: six days lost, cave ten miles off, zero marks, full health
works through six-year-old dispatchers; adults must ask a child
guards animal spirits; confiscates slingshots on sight
barefoot over ground that shreds boots; milk bowl always full
triple citizen: gnome, fairy, and its own office
persona.interview_style: cheerful, brisk, faintly superior about adult navigation skills

premise: Toddler-sized search-and-rescue that outperforms the state
